blocks.text: Biome ek bara aur alag pehchan wala jughrafiyai ilaqa hai jis ki pehchan us ki khaas aab-o-hawa (climate), mitti, oonchai (altitude) aur un halaat ke mutabiq dhale hue paudon aur janwaron ki qismon se hoti hai.

Pakistan ka mukhtalif jughrafiya kai biomes banata hai. Maslan Coniferous Forest Biome Murree aur Swat ke oonche ilaqon mein hai, jahan sakht sardiyan aur cheer/pine ke darakht zyada hain. Desert Biome Thal aur Thar ke ilaqon mein hai, jahan barish kam hoti hai aur cactus jaise Euphorbia (thohar) jaise khaas "succulent" (pani jama karne wale moti patton/tanon wale) paude milte hain. Isi tarah Freshwater Biomes mein Indus River ka bara nizam shamil hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Thal aur Thar ke registan ke succulent paudon ki misaal cacti deti hai. Asal cacti America ke paude hain aur yahan qudrati tor par nahin ugte. Yahan ke cactus jaise succulent paude zyada tar Euphorbia (thohar) hain; nagphani (prickly pear, Opuntia) cactus hai jo America se laya gaya.
